title: Bechet's lead playing and advice on registers
summary: Bechet liked taking the lead melody and told Wilber to cover all registers.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: I just wondered though in general if he had tried to avoid using a trumpet sometimes so he could be take the lead more himself if he enjoyed it or what do you think? did he ever express it?
I think he enjoyed playing the lead melody yeah
actually soprano sax is near a trumpet and a clarinet almost in some respects

and in some of his records even where he has a trumpet he has the trumpet play a second part and he'll play the melody on soprano yeah he liked to feel like he was leading the whole thing which he could do so well you know

well one other question in regard to your lessons did he ever discuss playing in different registers like you talk about the very high notes or sticking to a low register chorus or any advice on anything of that kind?
he liked to have me play across the registers
don't stick to one register and then to another you know cover the whole range of the instrument
even in one chorus or one solvon
yeah although actually when he played clarinet he would stick more to one register or the other but this was because he was a little scared about it uncertain yeah
